people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”
translations.bsb: Then Jesus declared, “No one who puts his hand to the plow and then looks back is fit for the kingdom of God.”
translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
translations.asv: But Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
